record.paper: On a conjecture of Mohar concerning Kempe equivalence of regular graphs

dossier_meta.paper: On a conjecture of Mohar concerning Kempe equivalence of regular graphs
dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open case: WSK algorithm on the triangular lattice for q=5
dossier_meta.statement_text: Determine whether the Wang-Swendsen-Koteck\'{y} algorithm for $q = 5$ colourings of the triangular lattice (with periodic boundary conditions) is valid (i.e., whether the set of $5$-colourings of the triangular lattice is a Kempe class).
dossier_meta.context_text: Theorem 2.2 establishes that the WSK algorithm on the triangular lattice is valid for $q \geq 6$ (via Theorem 1.1 and a degeneracy lemma) and invalid for $q \leq 4$ (Mohar and Salas). The authors explicitly note that $q = 5$ is the single remaining open case.
